pass_a_gloss: Lord shepherds me, and nothing me will-lack. Into place of-green-grass, there me he-encamped, upon water of-rest he-nourished me. Perfect the according-to image of-God and likeness being-known, to-whom also king, but not shepherd is-inscribed Lord; the and progressing in introduction, sheep would-be-called of-God, and is-shepherded by him, and the gospel he-feeds, and drinks water, of-which the having-drunk not thirsts; not-yet and of-the true vine the wine, and he-rests through ransom of-regeneration, putting-off the of-sins burden. And otherwise and the the meek and steady having-accomplished of-Christ, by him is-shepherded upon the green-grass, which is ethical teaching, in which he-encamped me, he-says, but not he-settled-as-house. And elsewhere and, he-says: himself shepherds us into the ages. See and understand the green-grass, and intelligible of-it place, and intelligible of-rest water, to-the still being-shepherded being-given, until of-rational table, and cup to-partake someone might-be-able. If still something not killing letter, that will-be green-grass; to-ones-being-shepherded and spiritually table having-been-prepared, to-the enduring the afflictions.
pass_b_english: “The Lord shepherds me, and nothing will fail me. Into a place of green grass, there he encamped me; by water of rest he nourished me” (Psalm 22:1-2).

The perfect one, known according to the image of God and likeness, for whom the Lord is inscribed also as king, but not as shepherd; but the one progressing in introduction would be called a sheep of God, and is shepherded by him, and feeds on the gospel, and drinks water of which he who drinks will not thirst; but not yet the wine of the true vine, and he rests through the ransom of regeneration, putting off the burden of sins.

And otherwise, the one who has accomplished the meek and steady of Christ is shepherded by him upon the green grass, which is ethical teaching, in which “he encamped me,” he says, but did not settle me as a house. And elsewhere he says: “he himself shepherds us unto the ages.”

And see and understand the green grass, and its intelligible place, and intelligible water of rest, given to the one still being shepherded, until someone can partake of a rational table and cup. If there is still something that is not a killing letter, that will be green grass; but for those shepherded spiritually, a table prepared, for those who endure the afflictions.

choices.term: ᾧ καὶ βασιλεὺς, ἀλλ' οὐ ποιμὴν ἐπιγράφεται Κύριος
choices.english: for whom the Lord is inscribed also as king, but not as shepherd
choices.why: The perfect has the Lord as king; the beginner as shepherd. Not ‘the Lord is never shepherd’.
rejected: the perfect is still only a sheep

choices.term: κατεσκήνωσέ με, φησίν, ἀλλ' οὐ κατῴκισε
choices.english: he encamped me, he says, but did not settle me as a house
choices.why: Tenting is not yet dwelling. OCR κα τῴκισε.
rejected: he settled me as a permanent house already

choices.why: Lock prints λυτροῦ, not silently read as λουτροῦ. Keep the printed form.
rejected: through the washing of regeneration as a silent emendation of the lock
regeneration is postponed until the wine
